The control thermocouple and the tube pressure gauge are installed and reporting.

evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.973 Torr at 100.6 sccm Ar.
Pressure rose to 3.087 Torr despite unchanged Ar flow of 100.6 sccm.
Pressure continued rising to 3.228 Torr at 99.8 sccm Ar, while temperature remained on target at 750.2 °C; this departs from the earlier stable pressure near 3 Torr.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null readings cannot verify the growth atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure verification and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to identify the pressure-rise cause. A functioning exhaust O2 sensor is needed to verify the required atmosphere; sample characterization is not yet available.
